questions.question: When exiting a bus during the basic vehicle control skills test, you must:

options.text: Keep both hands on the handrail.
Not touch the handrail.
Hold the handrail firmly.
Rush down the stairs.

questions.explanation: When you exit the bus during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. For a bus, always hold the handrail. If you exit incorrectly, you will automatically fail the test.

questions.question: When exiting your vehicle, you must maintain ____ with the vehicle at all times.

options.text: One point of contact
Four points of contact
Three points of contact
Two points of contact

questions.explanation: When you exit your vehicle during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. For a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly will result in automatic test failure.

questions.question: When students are picked up by a school bus:

options.text: The students should wait at a designated bus stop.
The driver should pick up students at any location.
The parents should choose the bus stop location.

questions.correctAnswerText: The students should wait at a designated bus stop.
questions.explanation: A school bus driver should pick up and drop off students only at approved bus stops. The school district must approve all stops.

questions.question: When doing an offset back/left parking maneuver, you should:

options.text: Pull straight forward, then back to the right.
Pull straight forward, then back to the left.
Pull forward to the right, then back straight.
Pull forward to the left, then back straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull straight forward, then back to the left.
questions.explanation: For an offset back/left parking maneuver, pull straight forward first, then back up to the left. Your vehicle must stay completely within the parking space boundaries.

questions.question: When alley docking, your vehicle should be parked:

options.text: With the front bumper on the front boundary line.
With the rear wheels over the rear boundary line.
Straight within the parking space boundaries.
At an angle within the parking space boundaries.

questions.correctAnswerText: Straight within the parking space boundaries.
questions.explanation: When alley docking, pull past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary. Then back your vehicle straight into the alley. Your vehicle must be parked straight and completely within the space boundaries.

questions.question: During the on-road driving test, you should:

options.text: Choose your own route to show off your skills.
Follow the examiner's directions.
Bring a passenger to ride with you.
Drive in an unsafe way.

questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, listen to and follow all directions from the examiner. They will never ask you to drive unsafely.

questions.question: When asked to change lanes during the skills test, you should:

options.text: Check traffic first.
Skip using your mirrors.
Cut off other vehicles if needed.
Not make the lane change if you don't want to.

questions.explanation: You will make several lane changes during the driving skills test. Before changing lanes, check traffic carefully and use your signals. Change lanes smoothly and safely.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you will NOT have to:

options.text: Walk around the vehicle.
Point to or touch each item.
Explain what you are checking and why.
Crawl under the vehicle.

questions.explanation: To earn your CDL, you must pass an inspection test. Walk around the vehicle and point to or touch each item. Explain what you are checking and why. You do not need to crawl under the vehicle or hood.

questions.question: Once you stop for the stop/start maneuver, you should:

options.text: Turn on the four-way flashers.
Not use the four-way flashers because it is just a test.
Leave the vehicle in first gear.
Park in front of a fire hydrant.

questions.explanation: Once stopped for the stop/start maneuver during the on-road driving skills test, turn on your four-way flashers and shift into neutral or park. Do not block driveways, intersections, fire hydrants, or signs.

questions.question: School buses:

options.text: Never have ABS.
Only have ABS in cold climates.
May have ABS.

questions.explanation: Most commercial vehicles made after 1998 or 1999 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS). Many older buses also have ABS.

questions.question: When checking springs during a vehicle inspection, do all of the following except:

options.text: Look for missing leaf springs.
Look for broken coil springs.
Make sure torsion springs are not damaged.
Glue cracked leaf springs.

questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection, check for missing, shifted, cracked, or broken leaf springs. Also check for broken or distorted coil springs. If the vehicle has torsion bars or torque arms, make sure they are not damaged and are mounted securely.

questions.question: If your vehicle has a cargo lift, you should make sure that:

options.text: The lift is loosely attached.
The lift is not leaking.
The lift is fully extended.
The lift is the proper color.

questions.explanation: When checking a cargo lift, look for leaks, damage, and missing parts. The lift must be fully retracted and latched securely.

questions.question: Why should a school bus stop a short distance from waiting students?

options.text: Students will walk to the bus, making it easier for the driver to watch them.
Students will usually be waiting on a sidewalk.
Students may get scared if the bus comes toward them.
Buses are difficult to drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Students will walk to the bus, making it easier for the driver to watch them.
questions.explanation: A school bus should stop at least 10 feet away from waiting students. This makes students walk toward the bus, making it easier for the driver to watch their movements.

questions.question: Before leaving a bus stop, a driver should:

options.text: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus.
Make sure students have placed their backpacks in the aisle.
Make sure students have opened the emergency vent.
Make sure students are facing the rear of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus.
questions.explanation: Before pulling away from a bus stop, check that no students are running to catch the bus.

questions.question: When taking the on-road driving test, you must do all of the following except:

options.text: Wear your safety belt.
Obey all traffic signs.
Complete the test without an accident.
Demonstrate that you can use your cell phone while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Demonstrate that you can use your cell phone while driving.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, drive safely and responsibly. Wear your safety belt, obey all traffic signs and laws, and complete the test without accidents or moving violations.

questions.question: Your vehicle's final position should be:

options.text: Exactly where the examiner instructed.
Within five feet of the examiner's instructions.
Wherever you can safely park.
Within two feet of the examiner's instructions.

questions.explanation: Park your vehicle in the exact position the examiner describes. Failing to complete an exercise exactly as instructed may result in failing the basic control skills test.

questions.question: During a pre-trip inspection, you should make sure that:

options.text: The pedal surface has been smoothed out.
The gas pedal sticks.
Nothing is blocking the pedals.
There is something underneath the brake pedal.

questions.explanation: Check that nothing under or around the pedals will block their use. Make sure the pedals work properly and have grooved surfaces where applicable.

questions.question: When inspecting engine belts during the vehicle inspection test:

options.text: The belts should be checked for snugness, with up to three inches of play.
The water pump belt does not need to be identified.
The air compressor belt should be removed.
You must identify which items are not belt-driven, if any.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must identify which items are not belt-driven, if any.
questions.explanation: Check the power steering, water pump, alternator, and air compressor belts for cracks and frays. Allow up to three-quarters of an inch of play at the center of each belt. If any of these items are not belt-driven, identify them and make sure their components work properly, are not damaged or leaking, and are mounted securely.

questions.question: The overhead rearview mirror is located:

options.text: On the outside left of the bus.
On the outside right of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: In a school bus, the overhead rearview mirror is mounted directly above the windshield on the driver's side.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Parallel park.
Inspect your tires.
Monitor your gauges.
Pull forward into a parking space.

questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.
